title: WEEK 1! WOW!
author: Penny Inks
summary: Who's the best? Who's the worst???? My week 1 impressions!!!
body:
**HIIII MARIO MANIA LEAGUE!**

My name is Penny and I'm a MASSIVE fan of the Mario Mania League! Thank you sooooo much for allowing me to write in!~

*Let me tell you about my first impressions! It'll be a little rambly... but that's just how I am!!!* ❤️ 

**SPOILERRRRSSS**


**AYA BREA AND TONY SOPRANO: DYNAMIC DUO???**

An impressive pair of debuts for the Goon Squad! Aya CONSISTENTLY got onto base and Tony hit that crazy home-run! These Miis are going to put in work if they keep that momentum up!

**FROM THE STARS ABOVE: BIG WINNERS AND LOSERS!**

This season sees the implementation of stars to give one player a massive boost, and it seemingly has helped a ton of these players! Not all of them though...

Standouts to me were **King K. Rool, Bowser, Green Dry Bones and Green Kritter.** Obviously those meaty power hitters got even meatier, with Bowser's hits rocketing to the moon, and King K. Rool making way better contact! Green Dry Bones SHOCKED me with his own homer, thanks to the star!!!

Surprise failures though were **DK and King Boo**. You would THINK that star would assist, but besides one DK dinger, they didn't do a whole lot more with this privilege.... :(

**GLITZVILLE GLAMOUR CRUSHES IT!!!**

Everyone was gossiping about the pure power of the Star Road Superstars, but the Glamours DESTROYED Sarasaland Sandstorm with a 13 run differential (thank you no mercy!) People underestimated how good this team was (and ANY team with THE Big Papi is incredible to me!!!!)

That's all for now! I just wanted to yap a little, and thank you again MML team for allowing me to write in!!!! I hope you'll have me back someday! 😀

-Penny Inks

title: Week 1 Predictions
author: Mr. Stats Man
summary: A lot of toss ups in week 1!
body:
# Week 1 Predictions

**Wild Woods 1-Uppers** @ OHIO 2
*Stadium - Daisy Cruiser, Nighttime*

I'll take Wild Woods from mercy rule.  OHIO 2 is going to realize that it won't be able to keep up with WW's power hitters the second Birdo steps onto the mound.

**FINAL SCORE:** 15-2

--

Petalburg Koopa Troopas @ **Pi'illo Island Dreamers**
*Stadium - Mario Stadium, Day*

Honestly, I'm looking at Pi'illo's roster and think that they have such a balanced team, that they will just hit every hole and Petalburg won't be able to do anything about it.  It really does come down to whether or not Petalburg can set up their powerhouse players, and the record shows that Pablo will mess everything up for them.

**FINAL SCORE:** 7-9

--

Goon Squad @ **Bean Bean Brigade**

DK is going to be the savior of the triple B.  Just like last season on OHIO, the leader of the DK crew will hit 3 home runs and win the game off.  I'm expecting a walk off homer from him.

**FINAL SCORE:** 5-9

--

Flipside Flappers @ **Star Road Superstars**

Flappers is going to need ZA WARUDO to win this one.  And unfortunately, they're against Bowser and his crew.

**FINAL SCORE:** 4-9

--

Sarasaland Sandstorm @ **Glitzville Glamours**

Sandstorm has a rather middling roster with no home run makers.  Glamour under the new captain, Weird Al, also has a lot to prove.  This one will be the closest, and it will be small ball.

**FINAL SCORE:** 3-4

--

With 9 innings, expect more blowouts than last season, especially with no mercy rule.

title: PRE-WEEK 1 POWER RANKINGS
author: Mr. Stats Man
summary: Who does Mr. Stats Man think is the best team?  Who is the worst?
body:
# Mr. Stats Man's Power Rankings

Now this may be way too early to be judging some of these teams, but we have Season 2 stats to look at, which means we can at least estimate some of these teams!

**#1 - Star Road Superstars**
Rory does it again.  She easily drafted the scariest team with Bowser as their powerhouse.  He was the best hitter last season without a doubt.  Boomer and the dry bones trio are also just fantastic addition to Bowser's army.  The only concern that's around are Blue Shy Guy and Noki, who didn't really play last season.


**#2 - Wild Woods 1-Uppers**
Typh kept some of her most important players, including first round pick Wiggler and K. Rool.  No Bowser this year, but Wario looks to make up for that.  Pianta and Magikoopa round out the roster.  Yellow Yoshi is brand new to the league, and could offer a lot.  I've heard the Yoshis were training off season on their island.  Lastly, Baby Daisy could bring some niche to the team.

**#3 - Pi'illo Island Dreamers**
It's time to slap.  This team will slap.  They're all about contact and on hit percentage.  Especially with Blue Pianta and Red Toad on this team.  Red Kritter is here to try and bring everyone home also.  Two Yoshis here too, really supporting the story that they got buffer over the off season.  Only real reason they're below WW is because Kritter is the only power batter, but teams don't need home runs to win.

**#4 - Bean Bean Brigade**
Brand new to the league, Daxx made a statement by taking DK as his first pick.  Donkey Kong was one of the best batters in the league last year, basically carrying all of OHIO on his back.  Funky Kong adds some more power.  However there's a lot of question marks.  Myrtle basically sat on the bench all of last year on NNNYM.  Monty Mole and Paragoomba had no playing time either.  Maybe this is ranking them too far up given the rest of the team, but Donkey Kong kind of carries teams, so we'll see if he can do it again.

**#5 - Petalburg Koopa Troopas**
Their top 3 is fantastically solid.  Petey needs zero explanation as the MVP of Season 2.  Waluigi had one of the best batting averages last season.  King Boo also offered some important power on the team.  The world series runner ups also managed to re-draft their defensive wall of Petey, Pablo, and Kukrushka.  What will decide this team's fate will be the performance of Goomba, Koopa, and Pablo at the bat.

**#6 - Glitzville Glamour**
Something doesn't sit right with the composition.  Big Papi (Fire Bro) is obviously a star, but the rest of the lineup is kind of flat.  Bowser Jr. brings in some tricks, but there really aren't a lot of game changers.  It's truly going to be some standard baseball out there with this middling roster.


**#7 - Flipside Flappers**
This was easily the hardest team to rank.  One one hand, the team has some good hitters.  One the other, the GMs were literally debating on taking "spicy" or "troll" picks. Not a lot of home runs to their player's names.  They also drafted Baby Luigi, who is notorious for being a terrible baseball player.  This team's strategy will be small ball, and they will need to figure out their way of play fast.

**#8 - Goon Squad**
Green Kritter is a fantastic batter.  Hammer Bro is also a good power hitter.  What really stunk for this team was being forced into picking Diddy Kong, who does NOT sport great stats.  Unfortunately, the whole team as a whole has one of the worst OPS around.

**#9 - Sarasaland Sandstorm**
This roster has hit a collective total of *ZERO* home runs.  The double captains is neat, but that's pretty much all this team has.  Supposedly they had a plan with drafting Boo in the 4th, but were denied by Goon Squad.

**#10 - OHIO 2**
This sequel is going to lose, and it's going to be because they do NOT have the outfield core they need.  In order for the team to have chemistry, they need to have Birdo in the outfield and unfortunately she WILL be the sub for pitching once the starter is tired.  This means that home runs will be flying over this team the second the pitcher changes.  It's just this sole fact that unfortunately, may cost this team some wins.
